title: TensorPlate Scheduler Config
description:
Runtime configuration consumed by the serving worker to construct an InferScheduler. Mirrors include/tensorplate/scheduler/scheduler.hpp::SchedulerConfig.

Only the 'fifo' policy is registered; 'session_round_robin' is reserved. A policy string that no scheduler is registered under, reserved or not, is rejected with Error::Code::Unsupported when the serving worker builds its scheduler, and the worker does not start. All durations are monotonic; wall-clock time is never consulted.

policy.description: Stable scheduler policy key. 'fifo' dispatches admitted requests in arrival order. 'session_round_robin' is reserved for a policy that dispatches round-robin across the session keys of queued requests, first-in first-out within one key; no scheduler is registered under it. The same enum is copied into protocol/schemas/scheduler_metrics.json and protocol/schemas/scheduler_event.json, which echo the key.

queue_capacity.description: Maximum admitted-but-undispatched depth. Admission past this returns Error::Code::OOMError.

in_flight_capacity.description: Maximum number of dispatched requests that count toward the in-flight limit at once. SchedulerConfig::in_flight_capacity in include/tensorplate/scheduler/scheduler.hpp says which dispatched requests count.

deadline_margin_ms.description: Deadline-margin in milliseconds. The scheduler accepts a request whose estimated completion is at most this many milliseconds later than its deadline.

default_service_estimate_ms.description: Service-time estimate in milliseconds when no per-request estimate is available.

pressure_reject_threshold.description: Pressure severity at which new admission is rejected. 'normal' disables pressure-based rejection (record-only mode); 'critical' is the recommended v0.1.0 default.
